description: Subscribe a person to The Pulse by email with their explicit newsletter consent and chosen format, frequency and language. Validate with dryRun:true first. Live calls store a subscription, send a confirmation email and notify the team. Save an idempotencyKey before sending and reuse it with identical input for retries within 7 days; never retry an uncertain action with a new key.

confirmed.description: Set true only after the person explicitly approves sending these details to RegusciLabs.

consent.description: The person explicitly opted into The Pulse. An inquiry does not imply newsletter consent.

dryRun.description: Defaults to true: validate only, with no delivery or storage. Set false only for an approved live submission.

idempotencyKey.description: Unique key for one approved live action. Reuse it with identical input for retries for 7 days; use a new key for a different intended action. Without a key, automatic retry is unsafe.

name: subscribe_pulse
